correctness.rationale: The four-state de Bruijn path correspondence is proved by induction, and exhaustive closure of all reachable nonempty subsets gives a finite unrestricted decision procedure. Exact reexecution across all 256 rule tables yields the seven counts 24/90/72/12/4/4/50, unique length-six extremizers 37/91/164/218, and 32,256 independent direct word/preimage comparisons. A closed non-singleton reachable set proves no word of any length succeeds for 50 rules.

value.rationale: Shortest observable right-boundary recovery is a motivated intrinsic inverse problem for ECA outputs. The result fully classifies all canonical elementary rules and proves the sharp six-output-symbol observation cutoff, four extremizers and fifty genuinely nonrecoverable cases. This is a natural complete classification with useful sharp boundary, not a routine restatement or arbitrary subset.
